title: HORIZON — Quantum Gravity Atlas
description: An interactive, cinematic atlas of modern physics tracing the path from the Standard Model to the open frontier of quantum gravity. Eight modules pair rigorous explanation with real-time 3D simulation and live formulas, with an honest accounting of what is established, what is an effective model, and what remains conjecture. Includes a symbol atlas of notation conventions, an interactive glossary, verified classic references, and reproducible visual QA.
